rows.label: tlk70000007_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Lately, my friend Marco and the others
seem to be making something...

rows.label: tlk70000007_03_msg0002
rows.name:
He keeps saying, 'Leave it to me!'
and won't tell me what it is.

rows.label: tlk70000007_03_msg0003
rows.name:
S-sorry for complaining about things
like this to all of you...

rows.label: tlk70000007_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Still, it seems they care about me,
and I don't mind that at all.

rows.label: tlk70000007_03_msg0005
rows.name:
I can't help lots of people the way
you all can, but...

rows.label: tlk70000007_03_msg0006
rows.name:
I'd love it I got the chance
to do something for Joey and
Tiko... And Marco, of course!
